summary: We trace the gold supply chain from a mine to a Delhi jeweller
content:
World Service , · 03 Nov 2026 , · 17 mins

Gold is worth about twice what it was four years ago, so who profits when a Hindu family buys gold during the Diwali festive period? Sam Fenwick traces the gold supply chain from a mine that digs up 140 tonnes of rock for a single ounce of gold to a Delhi jeweller, examining the role of central banks and refiners along the way. (Photo: A jewellery shop in Bangalore, India, 13 October 2025. Credit: Jagadeesh Nv/EPA/Shutterstock) You can email the team: businessdaily@bbc.co.uk Producer: Josh Martin and Huma Shah
chineseSummary: 我们追踪从矿山到德里珠宝商的黄金供应链
chineseContent:
全球服务，·2026 年 11 月 3 日，·17 分钟

黄金的价值约为四年前的两倍，那么当印度教家庭在排灯节期间购买黄金时，谁会获利呢？ Sam Fenwick 追溯了黄金供应链，从开采 140 吨岩石生产一盎司黄金的矿山到德里的一家珠宝商，研究了中央银行和精炼商在此过程中所扮演的角色。 （照片：印度班加罗尔的一家珠宝店，2025 年 10 月 13 日。图片来源：Jagadeesh Nv/EPA/Shutterstock）您可以向团队发送电子邮件：businessdaily@bbc.co.uk 制片人：Josh Martin 和 Huma Shah
